title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Mon 02 Nov
summary: A moderate day (forecast moderate). Thermals were strongest (moderate) about 12:00 to 16:00. The upslope ran from about 09:15 to about 16:00. A low day for November: the base stayed down near 3,900 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,000 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 3,900 ft by the Kekoa camera, 1,100 ft lower than the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,000 ft, off by 1,100 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest south about 10:52, crossing Kula Highway at the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 2 stations (Kahikinui, Upper Kahikinui); Nakula stopped at 10:30; the Mesonet could not be reached on 19 of 54 updates.
